statement: Over the 200 labelled queries in bench/queries.json, mean recall@10 stays at or above 0.85 and mean P@10 at or above 0.25 (measured level: 0.8533 / 0.2560). Relevant sets hold 3 documents, so P@10 is capped at 0.30 here; recall@10 is the sensitive half of the same measurement and is what the hidden P@10 judge rewards.
